entities.summary: Michael Remmers is an American former professional football offensive tackle who played in the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the Oregon State Beavers, where he finished his career with the sixth-most starts in school history. He signed as an undrafted free agent with the Denver Broncos in 2012 and played with six different franchises in his NFL career, and started in two Super Bowls.
